主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. released its financial results for the fourth quarter of 2012 and the full year ended December 31, 2012. The report was issued on January 30, 2013, and the full text of the press release is included as Exhibit 99.1. The information provided in the report is not considered "filed" under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, unless explicitly stated. The press release is intended to be furnished and not deemed "filed" for purposes of the Exchange Act. The report was signed by Richard L. Bergmark, Chief Financial Officer of Core Laboratories N.V.
